title: SQL Injection Testing with SQLMap
description: Learn to detect and exploit SQL injection vulnerabilities using SQLMap in a controlled lab environment. Practice automated database enumeration, blind SQLi exploitation, and WAF bypass techniques.

title: Nmap Network Scanning Fundamentals
description: Master the fundamentals of network scanning with Nmap. Learn host discovery, SYN vs TCP connect scans, service version detection, NSE scripts, and OS fingerprinting in a safe sandbox.

title: Linux Privilege Escalation
description: Practice escalating privileges on Linux systems. Exploit SUID binaries, misconfigured cron jobs, writable sudoers, kernel exploits (Dirty COW/Pipe), and automated LinPEAS enumeration.

title: Windows Privilege Escalation
description: Learn Windows local privilege escalation techniques including unquoted service paths, AlwaysInstallElevated registry keys, token impersonation (PrintSpoofer/JuicyPotato), and WinPEAS audits.

title: Basic Penetration Testing Lab
description: Your first penetration test from start to finish! Learn reconnaissance, network mapping, brute force attacks, web exploitation, and post-exploitation privilege escalation.

title: OWASP Top 10 Web Vulnerabilities
description: Hands-on practice auditing and exploiting the OWASP Top 10 web vulnerabilities including Stored/Reflected XSS, CSRF, SSRF, IDOR, Broken Access Control, and Insecure Deserialization.

title: Metasploit Framework Mastery
description: Deep dive into the industry-standard Metasploit Framework. Configure listeners, generate encoded payloads with MSFvenom, run auxiliary scanners, and establish persistent Meterpreter sessions.

title: Wireshark Packet Analysis & Traffic Forensics
description: Analyze network traffic like a digital forensics investigator. Filter unencrypted credentials, extract transferred malicious files from PCAP streams, and identify C2 beacon traffic.

title: Active Directory Attack & Defense
description: Attack and defend corporate Active Directory environments. Learn Kerberoasting, AS-REP roasting, DCSync attacks, BloodHound graph analysis, and Golden Ticket privilege abuse.

title: OSINT (Open Source Intelligence) Investigation
description: Master online investigation and reconnaissance. Gather target intelligence from DNS records, WHOIS databases, social media scrapers, satellite imagery, and Shodan IoT search engines.

title: Reverse Engineering & Malware Analysis
description: Dissect and analyze suspicious binary files in an isolated sandbox. Perform static disassembly with Ghidra, inspect PE headers, debug executable routines with x64dbg, and extract IOCs.

title: Burp Suite Certified Practitioner Prep
description: Master Burp Suite for professional web penetration testing. Learn HTTP request tampering, automated fuzzing with Intruder, custom match/replace rules, and Repeater workflows.

title: Cryptography & Hash Cracking Workshop
description: Break cryptographic ciphers and crack password hashes. Learn dictionary attacks, rule-based mutations with Hashcat, John the Ripper configurations, and modern symmetric/asymmetric algorithms.

title: Stack-Based Buffer Overflow Exploitation
description: Understand memory corruption vulnerabilities at assembly level. Find EIP register offsets, locate bad characters, generate shellcode, and craft reliable weaponized buffer overflow exploits.

title: OverTheWire: Bandit Wargame (Linux Mastery)
description: The ultimate hands-on wargame for mastering Linux command line, piping, file permissions, SSH keys, cronjobs, and basic scripting through 34 progressively challenging levels.

title: PortSwigger Web Security Academy: XSS Labs
description: Free enterprise-grade web security labs from the creators of Burp Suite. Practice Reflected XSS, Stored XSS, DOM-based XSS, CSP bypasses, and AngularJS sandbox escapes.

title: Hack The Box: Starting Point (Tier 0 & 1)
description: Beginner-friendly real target machines on Hack The Box. Learn service enumeration (FTP, SMB, Telnet, Redis), default credential attacks, and initial shell capture.

title: WiFi Hacking & WPA3/WPA2 Wireless Auditing
description: Audit wireless network security ethically. Capture 4-way handshakes, exploit PMKID zero-client vulnerabilities, build fake rogue AP evil twins, and crack hashes with Hashcat.

title: Android Application Penetration Testing
description: Decompile APK binaries with APKTool and JADX-GUI. Bypass SSL certificate pinning with Frida and Objection scripts, and audit exported Android activities and content providers.

title: PicoCTF Practice Challenges
description: Carnegie Mellon University's acclaimed cybersecurity challenge platform featuring live interactive exercises in Reverse Engineering, Cryptography, Web Exploitation, and Forensics.
